contract.task_clause:
Which of the following is a true statement about optical isomerism of complexes containing achiral ligands?
Option A: Square planar complexes can display optical isomerism only if all four ligands are identical.
Option B: Tetrahedral complexes never display optical isomerism.
Option C: Linear complexes can display optical isomerism when both ligands are different.
Option D: Octahedral complexes of monodentate ligands can display optical isomerism only when they have at least three different ligands.
